Container.Name: CNGI-Trades
Container.Overview: CNGI Trades is a private family-only multi-user trading workspace. Each family member connects their own isolated Alpaca PAPER account. Version 0.1.2 is read-only and locked: NO live trades or automated paper orders. Requires its own database on PostgreSQL 18 and Authentik OIDC.
Container.Requires: Dedicated cngi_trades database and dedicated least-privilege login on PostgreSQL 18, Authentik OIDC client, and Nginx Proxy Manager HTTPS forwarding to host port 8191. If GHCR package is private, authenticate Docker to ghcr.io first.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Unraid host port 8191 maps to Trades container port 8080. Point trades.clemonsnextgen.com proxy here.

Config.Name: Database URL
Config.Description: DEDICATED Trades PostgreSQL 18 database connection, never CNGI Core database. Format: postgresql+psycopg://trades:ENCODED_PASSWORD@POSTGRES_HOST:5432/cngi_trades. PostgreSQL must be reachable from this container.

Config.Name: Session Secret
Config.Description: Unique random string of at least 32 characters. Do not reuse CNGI Core's session secret.

Config.Name: Broker Credential Encryption Key
Config.Description: Fernet encryption key (generate once; preserve backups). Changing this key makes existing encrypted broker credentials unreadable. Do not reuse Core's key.

Config.Name: Allowed Family Login Emails
Config.Description: Comma-separated verified email addresses authorized for this family-only app; no public registration.

Config.Name: Public Trades URL
Config.Description: Canonical HTTPS address used for OIDC callback and secure session cookies. Login requires HTTPS through your proxy.

Config.Name: Authentik OIDC Discovery URL
Config.Description: Full Authentik OpenID discovery endpoint for the CNGI Trades provider, ending in /.well-known/openid-configuration. Use the URL shown by Authentik.

Config.Name: Authentik Client ID
Config.Description: Unique OAuth/OpenID client ID assigned to CNGI Trades in Authentik.

Config.Name: Authentik Client Secret
Config.Description: Client secret from the CNGI Trades Authentik OAuth/OpenID provider; never expose or commit.

Config.Name: Trusted Proxy IPs
Config.Description: Optional comma-separated reverse proxy source IPs allowed to supply forwarded headers. Never set * when accessible to untrusted clients.

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Log and host timezone. Market schedule will later use America/New_York.
